red_flags.evidence: approve the collect request

red_flags.evidence: enter your UPI PIN
red_flags.why_risky: You only need to enter your UPI PIN when you are sending money to someone, never to receive it.

red_flags.evidence: Offer valid for 10 minutes only
red_flags.why_risky: Scammers use time limits to pressure you into acting quickly without thinking.

red_flags.evidence: Congratulations! You have received ₹5000 from PhonePe Rewards
red_flags.why_risky: Unexpected messages claiming you have won or received money are almost always scams.

advice.summary: This is a scam. The message is trying to trick you into sending money from your account instead of receiving it.
do_now: Delete the message immediately.
Block the sender's number.
Ignore any further messages from this sender.
never_do: Never enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
Do not click any links or approve any collect requests.
Never share your PIN, OTP, or bank details with anyone.
advice.report: Report this scam at https://cybercrime.gov.in or call the 1930 cyber-crime helpline. If you have already lost money, contact your bank immediately.

red_flags.evidence: Can you send ₹8,000 to rohan.help@okaxis right now?
red_flags.why_risky: Scammers create fake emergencies to pressure you into sending money quickly without thinking.

red_flags.evidence: Please don't call, I can't talk.
red_flags.why_risky: Impersonators forbid calls to prevent you from realizing they are not the person they claim to be.

red_flags.evidence: Hey it's me Rohan, I changed my number.
red_flags.why_risky: Scammers often pretend to be a friend or relative with a new number to bypass your suspicion.

advice.summary: This is a scam. Someone is impersonating your friend to trick you into sending money urgently.
do_now: Call your friend on their original, old phone number to verify if they are actually in trouble.
Block the sender's number immediately on WhatsApp.
Delete the message after taking a screenshot for evidence.
never_do: Do not send any money to the UPI ID provided.
Do not reply to the message or engage with the scammer.
Do not share any personal or bank details with them.
advice.report: Report this scam at https://cybercrime.gov.in or call the 1930 cyber-crime helpline. If you have already sent money, call 1930 and your bank immediately.
